name: Cultist: Shadow Training doubles Gaze of C'Thun's healing (#1238)
contract: Shadow Training 805607 tooltip: 'Increases the healing done by Eldritch Mending by 50% and Gaze of C'Thun by 100%.' Spell.dbc effect 2 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, mask {0,4096,0}) already gives Eldritch Mending 500711 its native +50% (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE). Every Gaze of C'Thun rank (500110, 502135-502143) triggers 520335 which triggers 520333 (SpellFamilyFlags {2097152,0,1073741824}, family 31); a full Spell.dbc scan for family-31 spells with SpellFamilyFlags word0 bit 2097152 set returns only 520333, so a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE modifier masked to that single bit can only ever affect Gaze's heal helper. Before this fix no DBC row, SQL row or C++ script carried a second modifier for that helper.
